jobs.title: Payroll Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Axiom Human Resource Solutions**



We don’t believe in “one size fits all.” Instead, we provide unique solutions. We take the time to fully assess the client’s operation in order to contribute towards their goals becoming reality. We dig in and find the practices that prohibit our clients from being its efficient, effective, and productive best. And then we tailor a solution. Our goal is to help our clients Win with technology. We help that happen through experience and a dedicated staff who makes it a priority to customize programs that address our clients’ unique business needs.

  


**Our Values**


**A**bsolute Communication


**X**uberant


**I**nitiative


**O**wnership


**M**entor

  


**Role Overview**



The Payroll Implementation Specialist supports the onboarding of new clients and serves as the subject matter expert for UKG Ready payroll. Successful project implementations ensure continuity during the transition from prior software and provider, include accurate payroll history, identify and communicate issues in payroll history or expected payroll processing goals, provide direct training and support for first payroll runs, and coordinate with the internal Tax Team. This person will work as part of a team for blended projects including timekeeping, HR services, and external integrations.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Support the onboarding of new clients and serve as the subject matter expert for employee data, tax data, and payroll data along with best practices.
* Assist and train clients in utilizing our products and services with ease.
* Establish and manage positive relationships with new and existing clients through our Implementation process.
* Identify and create all necessary pre\-payroll and post\-payroll reporting including labor allocations, retirement contributions and census, general ledger, and more.
* Import, balance, and review full payroll history and applicable employee data with the client.
* Responsible for learning and understanding system capabilities – prior knowledge of UKG Ready timekeeping and/or timekeeping best practices is a plus.
* Collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot and grow existing best practices in the ever\-changing Human Capital Management space.

  


**Qualifications**


* Minimum 2 years’ experience in payroll implementation with UKG Ready or similar platform
* Experience implementing small or medium\-sized businesses preferred
* Ability to explain complex topics simply
* High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

  


**Key Competencies**


* Clear communication and client education
* Customer support and relationship management
* Problem\-solving and adaptability
* Attention to detail and accountability
* Empathy and patience

  


**Success Metrics**


* Accuracy and timeliness
* Client satisfaction and retention
* Reduction in errors and escalations
* Platform adoption and usage

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive salary and benefits
* Flexible work environment
* Ongoing training
* Collaborative team culture

jobs.title: Treasury Sales Implementation Coordinator
jobs.description:
Work Days: Monday \- Friday \| Hours of Operation: 8:00am \-5:00pm  

  

  

**Why Broadway Bank:**
  

We are one of the largest independently owned banks in Texas with offerings in personal and private banking, wealth management, business banking and mortgage lending.


**Position Overview:**


This role is responsible for the sales growth and implementation of treasury solutions to commercial clients and prospects. The position coordinates the onboarding and training of customers in "New" Commercial Product Solutions, including integrated payables and integrated receivables, among others. It partners with the Treasury Commercial Product Manager to ensure that client needs are met through quality service delivery. Additionally, this role provides post\-implementation follow\-up, product usage support, quality control of billing, and identifies cross\-selling opportunities to optimize client relationships.


**Essential Functions:**


* Lead and coordinate implementation calls with stakeholders (e.g., Client, Banker, Treasury Sales Officer, Treasury Operations Specialist, outside vendors) to facilitate seamless product delivery, ensuring active participation of all parties.
* Monitor and track the progress of product implementation in coordination with Operations and Vendors using Gantt charts or similar project management tools.
* Facilitate client training for all depository and treasury products partnering with treasury sales.
* Drive the sales growth of treasury solutions through a proactive calling effort, leveraging leads from internal partners and personal development of outside prospects.
* Assist the Treasury Commercial Product Manager (CPM) with referrals for new treasury solutions, including Integrated Payables and Receivables.
* Lead and schedule client sales presentations and product implementations, coordinating with all involved parties (Client, Banker, Treasury Sales Officer, Treasury Operations Specialist, and external vendors).
* Act as the primary liaison with treasury services to ensure timely setup of new CPM requests. Provide support for client inquiries related to the setup process.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews at regular intervals (30 days, 60 days) to ensure client satisfaction and the optimal usage of products and services.
* Evaluate operational aspects of ACH Origination and Remote Deposit Capture. Initiate the approval process for product exposure limits and advise underwriting teams on the appropriateness of exposure levels requested by clients.
* Regularly review and report on client analysis statements to ensure accurate billing. Address and resolve complex account analysis questions raised by clients.
* Periodically review analysis statements for cross\-selling opportunities within existing clients.
* Coordinate annual relationship reviews and product training sessions between Bankers and Treasury Sales teams to ensure alignment with client goals.
* Stay informed of ongoing product development initiatives and guide product opportunities to align with client needs.
* Utilize Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and data mining tools to develop targeted prospect lists, focusing on industries, companies, and firms within the Bank's strategic markets.
* Support special projects and initiatives as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* This position may require travel within the Bank’s geographic area.
  

  

  

**Experience \& Education:**


* 5 years of bank customer contact and/or sales experience, with a proven track record of success in customer service and sales growth.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and productively with peers to achieve shared goals.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills are required, with experience delivering presentations to small groups.
* 5 years of experience in bank operations or treasury management operations is preferred.
* 3\-5 years of treasury management sales experience within a bank is preferred.
* Membership in the SA Treasury Management Association or Association of Financial Professionals is a plus.
* A four\-year degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or equivalent experience is required.

**Skills \& Qualifications:**


* Proven ability to coordinate complex client implementations.
* Strong understanding of treasury management products and services, including ACH Origination and Remote Deposit Capture.
* Expertise in reviewing and analyzing client billing statements to ensure accurate charges and identify opportunities for revenue optimization.
* Ability to develop and execute strategic sales plans, including prospecting and cross\-selling within existing client relationships.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong client relationships.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM systems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate operational risks and recommend appropriate product exposure limits.
* Ability to adapt to new product developments and guide clients through product adoption processes.
* Experience with delivering and managing client training programs for treasury solutions.

**Other Requirements:**


* Ability to manage multiple client implementations concurrently while meeting deadlines.
* Requires the ability to lift, carry, push, pull weights or otherwise move objects weighing as much as 10 lbs. on a regular basis and/or for extended periods of time during the workday.
* Occasional overtime or extended hours may be required.

**We’re a culture that offers resources to benefit your overall health and well\-being:**


* Career Development and Mentorship Programs
* Generous paid time off, minimum 4 weeks
* Employee recognition, awards, and events
* Free vision insurance
* Retirement matching
* Tuition reimbursement

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**ONBOARDING SPECIALIST**



As an Onboarding Specialist, your contributions will ensure the Onboarding Team can consistently provide high\-quality social and developmental experiences to all new SpaceX employees. Your efforts will ensure we can maximize the Onboarding Team's impact on new hires, helping them become great SpaceX employees quickly. We are looking for someone detail\-oriented and outcome\-focused.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Help manage and scale the company's domestic onboarding program
* Lead design, development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of orientation and onboarding programs with innovative strategies and tools
* Partner with stakeholders across the company to update all new hire information for current company practices and policies
* Develop and act on a deep understanding of internal onboarding\-related systems (Workday, Jira, Greenhouse, etc.)
* Track metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of onboarding programs, then develop and execute recommendations for program improvements
* Assist in weekly orientation preparations
* Provide outstanding service to our customers by responding in a timely manner to their questions
* Identify and implement positive employee experiences to help new SpaceX employees adapt to company and team cultures quickly
* Partner with HR leadership to create and implement impactful onboarding\-related resources for hiring managers, company leadership, and other stakeholders in the onboarding process


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Bachelor's degree
* 2\+ years of professional experience in onboarding, learning and development, human resources, or program management


**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**


* High level of organization and attention to detail
* Prior experience leading projects from inception to implementation
* Strong multi\-tasking and time management skills
* Ability to learn quickly on the job
* High level of self\-motivation, initiative, and sense of urgency to get things done
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proactive problem solving skills
* Resilience and flexibility; the ability to work in a dynamic organization with rapidly changing needs
* Strong skills in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook
* Familiarity with SharePoint or other content management system
* Familiarity with Greenhouse and Workday a plus
* Expertise in onboarding


**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**


* Position requires ability to travel up to 20% of the time
* This is not a remote position and will require relocation if not already local to the Memphis, TN area
* Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**


* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.



Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX's Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com*.*

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed.


Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.


We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager / Senior Implementation Manager to join our Success Services team in the US. You will lead Front’s most complex customer implementations across net\-new onboarding, enterprise expansion, workflow transformation, migration, and adoption of new capabilities.


You will be the customer’s primary implementation partner and a senior advisor throughout the engagement. You’ll uncover business goals, translate complex processes into scalable Front workflows, establish the project operating model, lead change and enablement, navigate technical dependencies, and drive teams toward measurable value.


This is a hands\-on role for an experienced implementation leader. You will independently manage high\-stakes engagements while also improving how our team works through stronger playbooks, reusable solutions, coaching, and cross\-functional partnership.

**What will you be doing?**

* Own complex, multi\-workstream implementation engagements from discovery and solution design through launch, adoption, and value realization.
* Advise customer leaders on future\-state workflows, operating models, governance, and change—not simply configure stated requirements.
* Build and drive clear project plans, decision frameworks, stakeholder cadences, risk registers, and executive updates across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Lead discovery workshops that uncover business goals, process gaps, technical constraints, change risks, and measurable success criteria.
* Guide solution design involving permissions, integrations, data flows, automations, migrations, APIs, webhooks, and Front’s AI\-powered capabilities; independently handle common technical topics and engage specialists intentionally.
* Lead change management, enablement, cutover, and adoption strategies for teams moving from deeply embedded legacy tools and processes.
* Navigate escalations with calm judgment, clear ownership, and an ability to align customers and internal teams around trade\-offs and a path forward.
* Partner with Sales, Solutions, Account Management, Product, Engineering, and Support to define scope, resolve blockers, and improve the customer journey.
* Turn recurring customer needs into reusable implementation assets, playbooks, templates, and delivery improvements.
* Support team development through mentoring, thoughtful feedback, knowledge sharing, and leadership on strategic initiatives.
* Represent the customer voice and implementation perspective in product and operational decisions.

**What skills \& experience do you need?**

* 5\+ years of experience leading customer\-facing SaaS implementations, professional services engagements, technical programs, or similarly complex transformation work.
* A track record of independently owning complex implementations from discovery through sustained adoption, including multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and technical dependencies.
* Strong consultative and systems\-thinking skills; able to diagnose underlying business problems and recommend a practical future state rather than order\-take.
* Excellent project leadership, including scope, timeline, governance, risk, executive communication, and management of multiple concurrent priorities.
* Demonstrated change\-management experience, including stakeholder mapping, resistance management, enablement, cutover, and reinforcement after launch.
* Strong technical fluency across integrations, permissions, data flows, automations, migrations, APIs, and webhooks; able to learn products quickly and know when deeper expertise is needed.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, facilitate difficult decisions, and build trust across technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Sound judgment under pressure and experience recovering at\-risk projects or resolving escalations.
* Evidence of improving a services organization through reusable solutions, delivery methodology, enablement, mentoring, or operational improvements.
* Curiosity and practical judgment about AI and automation, including how to drive responsible customer adoption and improve personal effectiveness.

**What makes you a great fit?**

* You create clarity and momentum when the path is ambiguous.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and make recommendations grounded in customer outcomes.
* You connect business strategy, workflow design, technical constraints, and change management.
* You communicate credibly with executives while staying close to execution details.
* You anticipate risks early, make trade\-offs explicit, and recover quickly when plans change.
* You measure success by adoption and value—not activity or go\-live alone.
* You improve the system around you and help teammates raise their craft.

**Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.**

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary
* Equity (we are post\-series D \& backed by some of the best VCs in the US)
* Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible time off policy
* Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role
* Mental health support with Workplace Options
* Family planning support with Maven
* $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities
* Wellness Days \- Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays
* Winter Break \- Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day!

*Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *\&* *EU Privacy Notice*


Compensation Range: $155K \- $173K

Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.


We’re looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager / Senior Implementation Manager to join our Success Services team in the US. You will be the customer’s primary implementation partner and a senior advisor throughout the engagement. **What makes you a great fit?**


* You create clarity and momentum when the path is ambiguous.

jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Remote position: must reside in the Orlando, Osceola, Polk , or Brevard markets\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: EverHealth: Director of Onboarding + Implementation
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 690,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/


We are looking for a **Director of Onboarding \& Implementation** at **EverHealth** to join our Customer Experience leadership team. EverHealth is simplifying the business of healthcare through simplified, user\-centric software which streamlines the daily operations of healthcare practices. Our EHR and billing solutions give small and medium\-sized practices an integrated ecosystem of intuitive, easy\-to\-use products that work with how providers run and grow their business.


**About the Role**


We're seeking an operational and visionary **Director of Onboarding \& Implementation** to lead the team that gets new EverHealth customers live on our EHR and billing products. This role owns the customer journey from signed contract through go\-live and early adoption for a high\-volume base of small and medium\-sized practices, delivered almost entirely without onsite implementation. You will be equally comfortable setting the long\-term vision for how onboarding should work at EverHealth and rolling up your sleeves to redesign a workflow, resolve an escalation, or coach a team member through a difficult go\-live.


Your north star is time to first value: how quickly and reliably a new practice experiences the outcomes they bought our software to achieve. You will also evolve the team's approach from software training to consultative practice partnership — helping customers rethink and improve how they run their business rather than simply teaching them which buttons to click — and make onboarding a continuation of the sales relationship rather than a handoff away from it. Reporting to the VP of Customer Experience, this role will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership to shape how EverHealth brings new customers into the fold.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Vision \& Strategy:** Define and evangelize a multi\-year vision for onboarding and implementation at EverHealth, translating it into a concrete roadmap across the EHR and billing product lines.
* **Time to First Value:** Own time\-to\-first\-value as the team's primary metric, redesigning milestones, workflows, and staffing models to shorten it without compromising quality.
* **Continuing the Sale:** Partner with Sales to treat onboarding as an extension of the buying journey — reinforcing the original value proposition and building momentum for retention and expansion from day one.
* **Consultative Transformation:** Shift the team's operating model from feature training to consultative, workflow\-based implementation, coaching specialists to diagnose a practice's operations and recommend how to run it on EverHealth, not just how to use it.
* **Cross\-Product Coordination:** Simplifying onboarding motions across multiple product/feature adoptions (payments, RCM, etc) to one coordinated implementation rather than two disconnected projects.
* **Remote\-First Delivery Model:** Build and continuously refine a scalable, primarily virtual delivery model suited to a high\-volume book of small and medium\-sized practices, reserving onsite engagement for the rare exception.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead a team of managers and help support ongoing development of the existing management team and frontline specialists, building career paths that reward consultative skill as much as technical proficiency.
* **Process \& Playbook Development:** Create repeatable playbooks, journey maps, and tooling, powered by AI, that let the team scale efficiently as customer volume grows, without sacrificing a tailored feel for each practice.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Sales to close feedback loops, resolve systemic issues, and ensure a seamless handoff at every stage of the customer lifecycle.
* **Performance Measurement:** Define, track, and report on key onboarding metrics (e.g., time to first value, time to go\-live, onboarding CSAT, adoption at 30/60/90 days) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* **Escalation Management:** Serve as an executive point of escalation for at\-risk implementations, working cross\-functionally to get stalled onboardings back on track.

**Skills \& Experience**


**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years leading Onboarding, Implementation, or Professional Services teams in SaaS, including at least 3\+ years in a director\-level or equivalent leadership role.
* Proven experience building or scaling a high\-volume, remote\-first onboarding model for small and medium\-sized customers, not a heavy onsite/enterprise implementation environment.
* Track record of shifting a team's approach from transactional training to consultative, outcomes\-based customer engagement, driven by AI and foundational digital\-led content to optimize the experience.
* Deep fluency in time\-to\-value, adoption, and onboarding health metrics, with the ability to translate data into operational change.
* Experience managing onboarding across multiple, distinct products or workflows simultaneously.
* Strong executive presence and cross\-functional influence, with the ability to partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable processes, playbooks, and tooling from the ground up.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with EHR, practice management, or medical billing/revenue cycle management software.
* Background in healthcare technology, digital health, or working with small and medium\-sized healthcare practices.
* Experience navigating HIPAA\-compliant environments or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with onboarding/CS tooling (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Smartsheet, or similar).
* MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus.

**Where:** \[this is a remote role, however, proximity to Denver, CO is a plus. Given the team's remote\-first delivery model, travel is minimal — occasional travel for company or team on\-sites]


The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in\-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


**Benefits and Perks** (JUST U.S.):


* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid
* Robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Student Loan Repayment Program

**Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $170,000 \- $190,000 USD per year with an incentive variable in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

jobs.title: Director Clinical Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
**Crossroads Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Since 2005, Crossroads has been at the forefront of treating patients with opioid use disorder. Crossroads is a family of professionals dedicated to providing the most accessible, highest quality, evidence\-based medication assisted treatment (MAT) options to combat the growing opioid epidemic and helping people with opioid use disorder start their path to recovery. This comprehensive approach to treatment, the gold standard in care for opioid use disorder, has been shown to prevent more deaths from overdose and lead to long\-term recovery. We are committed to bringing critical services to communities across the U.S. to improve access to treatment for over 26,500 patients. Our clinics are all outpatient and office\-based, with clinics in Georgia, Kentucky, New Jersey, North and South Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees and patients.


***Day in the Life of a Director Clinical Systems Engineering***
================================================================

***Key Responsibilities:***
===========================

* Lead structured requirements elicitation with clinical, pharmacy, front office, revenue cycle, quality, and compliance stakeholders; facilitate workshops, workflow walkthroughs, and design sessions.
* Translate operational and clinical needs into clearly written functional and technical specifications that can be built, tested, and audited.
* Produce and maintain requirements artifacts, including current\- and future\-state workflow maps, user stories with acceptance criteria, configuration workbooks, requirements traceability matrices, and test scripts.
* Drive formal requirements review and sign\-off prior to build; manage scope, change requests, and downstream impact analysis.
* Evaluate whether business needs are best met through configuration, integration, third\-party solution, or process change, and present recommendations with cost, risk, and effort trade\-offs.

***Interfaces, Integration, and Data***

* Oversee interfaces and data exchange across the application portfolio, including HL7 v2 and FHIR messaging, laboratory and toxicology results, e\-prescribing and EPCS, PDMP, pharmacy and dispensing systems, and downstream reporting and analytics feeds.
* Support eligibility, claims, and remittance transaction flows (270/271, 837, 835\) through the organization’s clearinghouse and payer channels in partnership with the revenue cycle team.
* Monitor interface queues and error handling; lead root\-cause analysis and remediation with vendors, trading partners, and internal IT.
* Develop and validate reports and data extracts using SQL and native reporting tools; ensure data definitions are consistent across systems.

***Data, Reporting, and Analytics***

* Independently write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL across clinical, pharmacy, and financial data; build and maintain operational, regulatory, and executive reporting, extracts, and dashboards.
* Own data validation for migrations and system changes, including reconciliation queries, record and field\-level validation, exception reporting, and documented sign\-off criteria.
* Maintain the enterprise data dictionary and source\-to\-target mapping; investigate data integrity issues to root cause across configuration, interfaces, and workflow.
* Present findings, methodology, and limitations clearly to clinical, operational, and executive audiences; apply minimum\-necessary and 42 CFR Part 2 principles to all reporting and data sharing.

***Implementation and Migration***

* Serve as the technical lead for site migrations onto the target EHR platform, including data extract and mapping, conversion testing, load validation, cutover planning, go\-live support, and post go\-live stabilization.
* Define and execute validation protocols for high\-risk clinical and financial data, including dosing history, active orders, allergies, diagnoses, consents, and patient balances.
* Coordinate build, testing, and training readiness activities with implementation, help desk, and operations leadership to support wave\-based go\-lives.
* Document and escalate migration risks, defects, and decisions; maintain issue logs through resolution.

***Team Leadership and Service Delivery***

* Directly supervise two Clinical Applications Analysts, including work assignment, prioritization, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
* Establish and enforce intake, triage, and service level standards for application requests; balance project workload against production support escalations.
* Develop team competency in configuration, testing discipline, and documentation; build cross\-coverage to reduce single\-threaded dependencies.
* Partner with the help desk and implementation teams to ensure clean handoffs between project delivery and ongoing support.

***Vendor Management, Compliance, and Reporting***

* Manage day\-to\-day technical relationships with application vendors; review release notes, coordinate upgrades, plan regression testing, and hold vendors accountable to defect resolution timelines.
* Ensure system configuration and documentation support HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, DEA, SAMHSA and state OTP requirements, state licensure, CARF or other accreditation standards, and payer requirements.
* Maintain audit\-ready records of configuration changes, access reviews, validation testing, and system decisions.
* Report project status, risks, decisions, and key performance metrics to the Vice President, Clinical Applications and to senior leadership.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

***Preferred Education \& Experience***
=======================================

***Technical and Functional Competencies:***

* Advanced working knowledge of electronic health record and practice management system architecture, configuration, and release management.
* Demonstrated proficiency in requirements elicitation and documentation methods, including workflow mapping, user stories, functional specifications, and traceability.
* Working knowledge of healthcare integration standards and technologies, including HL7 v2, FHIR, APIs, and secure file transfer.
* Advanced, hands\-on SQL proficiency required — including multi\-table joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregation, and window functions — with the ability to independently query, validate, and reconcile data across disparate systems without analyst support.
* Working knowledge of healthcare EDI transactions and clearinghouse operations.
* Understanding of behavioral health and substance use disorder clinical workflows, documentation, and billing requirements.
* Demonstrated project management skills, including planning, resourcing, risk management, and structured status reporting to executive stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a small technical team.
* Demonstrated data fluency: able to structure an analytical question, validate the underlying data, and present the result credibly to executives. Experience with business intelligence tools and with native EHR report writers.

***Education and/or Experience*****:**

* Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, information systems, computer science, healthcare administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred. Equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered.
* Minimum of seven (7\) years of progressive experience in clinical application configuration, systems analysis, or EHR implementation required.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of direct people leadership or formal project leadership experience required.
* Demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end requirements gathering for clinical or enterprise software initiatives required.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with at least one enterprise EHR or practice management platform required; behavioral health, substance use disorder, or OTP platform experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting multi\-site EHR implementation, consolidation, or data migration required.
* Working knowledge of interfaces and integration (HL7, FHIR, API, SFTP) required. Demonstrated hands\-on SQL experience is required and will be assessed during the interview process.
* Knowledge of OTP and OBOT operations, including methadone and buprenorphine dispensing workflows, take\-home regulations, and 42 CFR Part 2, strongly preferred.
* Experience with a healthcare clearinghouse and familiarity with revenue cycle workflows preferred.
* Professional certification such as CPHIMS, CAHIMS, PMP, Certified Scrum Product Owner, Six Sigma, or vendor\-specific application certification preferred.
* Ability to travel to clinic sites as required to support implementations, go\-lives, and workflow assessments.
* Experience building reports, extracts, or dashboards used by operational or executive leadership required; experience owning data validation for a system conversion strongly preferred.

***Benefits Package***
======================

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* PTO
* Variety of 401K options including a match program with no vesture period
* Annual Continuing Education Allowance (in related field)
* Life Insurance
* Short/Long Term Disability
* Paid maternity/paternity leave
* Mental Health Day
* *Calm* subscription for all employees

jobs.title: Sage Intacct Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Partner One is a leading investment group with a 30\-year history of acquiring and growing successful software companies. Trusted by over 2,000 of the world’s largest corporations and governments, Partner One owns some of the fastest\-growing enterprise software companies globally.

*Due to growth and our commitment to continual improvement, we are looking for an energetic and talented Sage Intacct Implementation Specialist to join our team on a full time remote basis.*

**We are looking for someone who has a good understanding of Sage Intacct as well as other**

**solutions and technologies and how they can be used to transform businesses. The ideal candidate is someone who can take lead and take the responsibility of new Sage Intacct**

**implementations. We are a company that acquires other Software companies and this would be a recurring task upon new acquisitions.**

**Tasks \& Responsibilities**


Reporting to the Director of Finance, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

* Implement and support Sage Intacct accounting solutions and projects
* Deliver valued implementation services, ensuring objectives are met in accordance with the project management plans
* Show commercial awareness in decisions, actions and communications
* Conduct end\-user application training and provide appropriate documentation for follow\-up when required
* Oversight of application build, test and deployment activities
* Identify recommendations for additional services and products within and without the project scope
* Advising and guiding users on their journey from system selection to go\-live and post implementation support and beyond

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience with Sage Intacct, performing Intacct implementations and/or end\-user experience
* Must have experience juggling multiple projects simultaneously
* Quick learning skills and ability to take initiative in a fast\-paced environment
* Accounting experience with excellent understanding of financial software
* Knowledge or direct experience in native cloud accounting/ERP products (eg. Sage Intacct, Netsuite) and industry trends
* Post\-secondary education in Finance/Accounting, Business and/or Information Systems


\-


Partner One est un groupe d’investissement de premier plan qui possède **30 ans d’expérience dans l’acquisition et la croissance de sociétés de logiciels prospères**. Faisant confiance à plus de 2 000 des plus grandes entreprises et organisations gouvernementales au monde, Partner One détient certaines des sociétés de logiciels d’entreprise à la croissance la plus rapide à l’échelle mondiale.

*Dans le cadre de notre croissance et de notre engagement envers l’amélioration continue, nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e)* ***spécialiste en implantation Sage Intacct*** *dynamique et talentueux(se) pour se joindre à notre équipe à temps plein, en télétravail.*

**Nous recherchons une personne qui possède une bonne connaissance de Sage Intacct ainsi que d’autres solutions et technologies, et qui comprend comment celles\-ci peuvent être utilisées pour transformer les entreprises. La personne idéale sera en mesure de prendre les devants et d’assumer la responsabilité des nouvelles implantations de Sage Intacct. Comme nous acquérons régulièrement de nouvelles sociétés de logiciels, les implantations de Sage Intacct feront partie des responsabilités récurrentes du poste.**


Tâches et responsabilités
Relevant du directeur ou de la directrice des finances, la personne retenue sera responsable des tâches suivantes :

* Mettre en œuvre et assurer le soutien des solutions et projets de comptabilité Sage Intacct
* Fournir des services d’implantation de qualité, en veillant à ce que les objectifs soient atteints conformément aux plans de gestion de projet
* Faire preuve de sens commercial dans ses décisions, ses actions et ses communications
* Offrir de la formation aux utilisateurs finaux sur l’application et fournir la documentation appropriée pour assurer le suivi, au besoin
* Superviser les activités de configuration, de test et de déploiement de l’application
* Formuler des recommandations concernant des services et produits supplémentaires, qu’ils soient liés ou non à la portée du projet
* Conseiller et accompagner les utilisateurs tout au long de leur parcours, de la sélection du système jusqu’à la mise en production, puis fournir un soutien après l’implantation et au\-delà


Exigences* Minimum de **3 ans d’expérience avec Sage Intacct**, notamment en implantation de la solution et/ou comme utilisateur final
* Expérience dans la gestion de plusieurs projets simultanément
* Grande capacité d’apprentissage et aptitude à faire preuve d’initiative dans un environnement dynamique
* Expérience en comptabilité et excellente compréhension des logiciels financiers
* Connaissance ou expérience directe des solutions de comptabilité/ERP infonuagiques natives, notamment **Sage Intacct et NetSuite**, ainsi que des tendances du secteur
* Formation postsecondaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires et/ou systèmes d’information

jobs.title: ALPACA LIMS Sales Engineer | Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our innovative team as an ALPACA LIMS Sales Engineer and Implementation Specialist, where you will be at the forefront of delivering cutting\-edge Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) solutions tailored to meet the complex needs of scientific and enterprise laboratories. This dynamic role combines technical expertise with proactive sales engagement, empowering clients through seamless solution design, product demonstrations, and strategic collaboration. As a vital bridge between our product offerings and customer success, you will drive business growth while ensuring clients maximize the value of their LIMS investments. Your energetic approach will inspire confidence and foster long\-term partnerships in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical pre\-sales activities by delivering compelling product demos, technical presentations, and solution proposals that align with client needs.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with sales teams, product developers, and customer support to craft tailored LIMS solutions utilizing enterprise software platforms.
* Configure and implement comprehensive solutions leveraging cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, and VMware to optimize laboratory workflows and data management.
* Manage client relationships through effective communication, technical support, and troubleshooting to ensure successful deployment and adoption of the LIMS platform.
* Participate in project management efforts by coordinating implementation timelines, resource allocation, and deliverables to meet client expectations.
* Utilize CRM systems to track sales activities, client interactions, and deal progress efficiently.
* Assist in closing deals by providing technical expertise during negotiations and demonstrating how our solutions address specific laboratory challenges.

**Experience**

* Proven technical sales experience within a corporate or enterprise software environment, preferably in laboratory or scientific settings.
* Strong understanding of computer networking concepts including TCP/IP protocols, VPNs, firewalls, and network security best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; familiarity with virtualization tools like VMware is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in scripting languages SQL for automation tasks and solution customization.
* Solid knowledge of Windows Server operating systems and IIS for system configuration and troubleshooting.
* Excellent analysis skills for assessing client needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, conducting product demos, and supporting customer training sessions.
* Strong communication skills for engaging with clients at all levels while managing multiple projects within a fast\-paced environment.

Join us to leverage your technical prowess in a vibrant sales environment where your expertise directly impacts laboratory innovation!

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
